pages.text: In the morning, the yard grass was white with frost. Momo kept lifting and lowering their paws. The pads seemed cold.
"I'll put dry grass in Momo's house." Yuki went to the grass pile.
Yuki took an armful from the compressed bottom of the pile, without even touching it to check.
Yuki stuffed the grass into the doghouse. "That should be enough." Momo poked their nose inside.
Momo backed away and curled up under the porch. "Why won't you go in?"
Evening came. A damp smell rose from the doghouse.
Yuki put a hand inside. The grass was wet and cold. Momo slept beneath the porch.
Grandma asked, "Where did Momo sleep today?" Yuki looked beneath the porch.
The next day, grass spread in the sunshine rustled. Yuki felt it and chose only dry pieces. "These are completely dry."
Momo slipped into the doghouse, buried their nose in their tail, and fell gently asleep.
